summary: Glacier Bancorp filed an 8-K announcing the appointment of Byron Pollan as Senior Vice President and Deputy CFO, effective September 1, 2026, in a newly created role. He will succeed CFO Ron Copher upon Copher's previously announced retirement, now planned for mid-2027, after which Copher will stay in an advisory role for transition support. Pollan has 27 years of banking experience, including as Treasurer since 2017 and prior roles at CIT Bank and Freddie Mac. No deal terms or advisors were named. The filing is a routine transition announcement, not forced, but the succession event is the focus.
